event_summary: A brown oblong object moves from above a tall glass into blue liquid, producing waves and splashes before remaining submerged near the lower part of the glass.
raw_event_description: At the start, a tall transparent glass stands on a wooden tabletop with blue liquid in its lower portion and a green band around the glass near the liquid surface. A brown oblong object is held just above the glass opening by blue curved pieces. After a long still interval, the brown object moves downward through the opening into the liquid. The liquid surface rises and forms visible waves and splashes against the inside of the glass. The brown object becomes partly hidden by the blue liquid and is later visible near the lower side of the glass while the liquid surface gradually becomes calmer.

reasons: The glass, blue liquid, green band, brown object, and blue holding pieces are visible before the main downward motion.
The brown object is partly near the top edge but its main shape is visible.
